### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning                                                 |
| ----- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*   | god, deity, divinity, divine spirit, supernatural force |
| ~an   | *adj.* | godly, divine                                           |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- 神, lightning (申, [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Nature/za\|za]]) on an altar or tablet (示): signifying the presence of a spirit.
- Coincidentally, ᛋ means life-force in Futhork and 𓊳 is the Egyptian symbol for shrine.
#### Sound
- Related to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Concepts/qa\|qa]] (spirit)
- *a priori:* q=hidden power, ya=powerful energy
